title: DevOps Engineer

nodes.title: Linux Administration & Bash Scripting
nodes.subtitle: File systems, permissions, processes, systemd, bash automation, pipe redirection
learning_objectives: Manage Linux system processes and user permissions securely
Write robust bash automation scripts with error handling (set -euo pipefail)
feynman_prompts: Why should production bash scripts always begin with 'set -euo pipefail'?
key_misconceptions: Running production scripts as root without least-privilege service accounts

nodes.title: Networking Fundamentals: DNS, SSH & Firewalls
nodes.subtitle: TCP/IP, DNS records (A, CNAME, TXT), SSH key pairs, iptables/ufw firewalls, NAT
learning_objectives: Configure passwordless SSH authentication and troubleshoot connection failures
Manage DNS records and configure host-level firewall rules
feynman_prompts: How does asymmetric cryptography secure SSH connections without transmitting private keys?
key_misconceptions: Leaving SSH password authentication enabled on public internet-facing servers

nodes.title: Git Workflows & Trunk-Based Development
nodes.subtitle: Git branching models, merge vs rebase, git hooks, commit signing with GPG
learning_objectives: Implement trunk-based development with short-lived feature branches
Automate local pre-commit verification using Git hooks
feynman_prompts: Why does trunk-based development lead to faster release cadence than long-lived GitFlow branches?
key_misconceptions: Maintaining long-lived divergent feature branches that result in merge hell

nodes.title: Docker Containerization & Linux Namespaces
nodes.subtitle: Linux namespaces, cgroups, Dockerfile instructions, layer caching, image optimization
learning_objectives: Explain how Linux namespaces and cgroups isolate container processes
Author optimized multi-stage Dockerfiles that maximize build cache efficiency
feynman_prompts: Explain the technical difference between a virtual machine (hypervisor) and a Docker container (namespaces/cgroups).
key_misconceptions: Thinking containers are full virtual machines running separate guest OS kernels

nodes.title: Multi-Container Orchestration with Docker Compose
nodes.subtitle: Compose specifications, container networking, volumes, environment variables
learning_objectives: Orchestrate multi-tier local environments (web, api, database, cache) with Docker Compose
Manage persistent volume storage and custom bridge networks
feynman_prompts: How does Docker Compose DNS resolution enable containers to communicate by service name?
key_misconceptions: Hardcoding container IP addresses instead of using Docker internal service discovery

nodes.title: CI/CD Pipelines with GitHub Actions
nodes.subtitle: Workflows, runners, jobs, steps, environment secrets, matrix builds, caching dependencies
learning_objectives: Build automated continuous integration pipelines testing PRs on every commit
Configure dependency caching to cut pipeline execution times
feynman_prompts: What is the fundamental purpose of Continuous Integration (CI) in modern software delivery?
key_misconceptions: Hardcoding cloud deployment credentials directly into workflow YAML files instead of encrypted secrets

nodes.title: Kubernetes Architecture & Core Concepts
nodes.subtitle: Control plane, kubelet, API server, etcd, Pods, Deployments, ReplicaSets
learning_objectives: Explain how the Kubernetes control plane reconciles desired state against actual state
Deploy containerized applications declaratively using Pods and Deployments
feynman_prompts: Explain the role of etcd in a Kubernetes cluster and why its high availability is vital.
key_misconceptions: Deploying raw individual Pods directly instead of using managed Deployments

nodes.title: Kubernetes Networking, Services & Ingress
nodes.subtitle: ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, Ingress controllers, Ingress routing, cert-manager
learning_objectives: Route internal service traffic using ClusterIP and external traffic using Ingress
Automate TLS certificate issuance and renewal with cert-manager and Let's Encrypt
feynman_prompts: Explain how a Kubernetes ClusterIP Service load balances traffic across multiple backend Pods.
key_misconceptions: Exposing internal backend databases directly to the public internet via NodePort

nodes.title: Kubernetes Storage & Configuration
nodes.subtitle: ConfigMaps, Secrets, PersistentVolumes, PersistentVolumeClaims, StorageClasses
learning_objectives: Decouple application configuration using ConfigMaps and encrypted Secrets
Provision dynamic cloud storage using PersistentVolumeClaims and StorageClasses
feynman_prompts: Why should application configuration be injected via ConfigMaps rather than baked into container images?
key_misconceptions: Storing plain base64-encoded Kubernetes Secrets in public Git repositories

nodes.title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform
nodes.subtitle: HCL syntax, providers, resources, variables, state management, terraform plan/apply
learning_objectives: Provision cloud infrastructure declaratively using Terraform and HCL
Manage remote state locking securely using S3 and DynamoDB
feynman_prompts: Why is Terraform state locking essential when multiple engineers collaborate on infrastructure?
key_misconceptions: Manually modifying cloud resources in the web console, causing state drift

nodes.title: Terraform Modules & Multi-Environment Deployments
nodes.subtitle: Reusable modules, outputs, remote backends, dev/staging/prod workspace separation
learning_objectives: Author reusable, parameterized Terraform modules following industry best practices
Manage separated environments (dev, staging, prod) with isolated state files
feynman_prompts: How do Terraform modules enforce DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principles in infrastructure?
key_misconceptions: Sharing a single Terraform state file across development and production environments

nodes.title: Cloud Infrastructure: VPC, Compute & IAM
nodes.subtitle: VPCs, public/private subnets, NAT gateways, security groups, IAM least privilege
learning_objectives: Architect secure Virtual Private Clouds (VPC) with isolated private database subnets
Enforce strict least-privilege IAM policies for compute services and users
feynman_prompts: Why should production database instances always reside in private subnets with no public IPs?
key_misconceptions: Assigning broad administrator permissions (AdministratorAccess) to service accounts

nodes.title: Observability: Metrics with Prometheus & Grafana
nodes.subtitle: Time-series metrics, PromQL, exporters, Grafana dashboards, alerting rules
learning_objectives: Instrument systems and extract metrics using node-exporter and Prometheus
Design informative Grafana dashboards and configure multi-channel alerting rules
feynman_prompts: What are the Four Golden Signals of monitoring (Latency, Traffic, Errors, Saturation)?
key_misconceptions: Setting up threshold alerts without clear runbooks, resulting in alert fatigue

nodes.title: Centralized Logging: Loki & ELK Stack
nodes.subtitle: Log aggregation, FluentBit, Promtail, Grafana Loki, structured log queries
learning_objectives: Collect and aggregate container logs across cluster nodes using FluentBit/Promtail
Query logs with LogQL and correlate log messages with Prometheus metric spikes
feynman_prompts: Why is log aggregation essential in distributed multi-pod Kubernetes clusters?
key_misconceptions: SSHing into individual nodes to view raw log files during production outages

nodes.title: Site Reliability Engineering: SLIs, SLOs & Error Budgets
nodes.subtitle: Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), error budgets, blameless postmortems
learning_objectives: Define measurable SLIs and realistic SLO targets for production services
Manage release velocity using error budgets and conduct blameless postmortems
feynman_prompts: How does an error budget balance innovation velocity against system reliability?
key_misconceptions: Treating 100% uptime as an SLO, creating prohibitive costs and stifling feature releases

nodes.title: Secret Management with HashiCorp Vault
nodes.subtitle: Dynamic secrets, encryption-as-a-service, Vault agent injector in Kubernetes, secret rotation
learning_objectives: Inject dynamic credentials into Kubernetes Pods securely using HashiCorp Vault
Enforce automatic secret rotation policies across cloud infrastructure
feynman_prompts: Why are dynamic, short-lived secrets safer than long-lived static credentials?
key_misconceptions: Storing long-lived database passwords in static configuration files

nodes.title: GitOps & Declarative Delivery with ArgoCD
nodes.subtitle: GitOps principles, ArgoCD, declarative sync, automated drift detection, rollbacks
learning_objectives: Implement GitOps continuous delivery where Git is the single source of truth
Automate cluster deployment synchronization and handle one-click rollbacks with ArgoCD
feynman_prompts: Explain how GitOps eliminates manual kubectl deployments and prevents configuration drift.
key_misconceptions: Modifying live cluster resources using kubectl directly, bypassing Git version control

nodes.title: Disaster Recovery, High Availability & Chaos Engineering
nodes.subtitle: Multi-region failover, automated backups, RTO/RPO metrics, chaos engineering principles
learning_objectives: Calculate Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) for critical services
Test system resilience and fault-tolerance using chaos engineering experiments
feynman_prompts: What is the difference between RTO (how fast you recover) and RPO (how much data you lose)?
key_misconceptions: Assuming backups work without conducting scheduled disaster recovery restore tests

description: Master DevOps Engineer with an industry-standard, comprehensive curriculum spanning 18 core and advanced milestones.
